This precedent, coupled with the robust evidence, strongly supports the application of the standard 4-year ban outlined in the anti-doping code. Reducing the suspension to one year would undermine the integrity of the code and send a dangerous message regarding the seriousness of doping violations.

Therefore, we recommend applying the standard 4-year ban as outlined in the code to deter future violations and protect the spirit of fair play.
